text: Laoboshi DSH App Manager（劳博士 DSH 桌面客户端插件）：在桌面 DSH 中登记并管理本地应用。它通过 shell overlay 和设置页入口打开应用管理面板，可登记或识别项目、分配端口、启动和停止应用，并查看运行日志及维护 API 文档。适合希望在 DSH 中集中管理本机开发项目的用户。使用需要劳博士 Desktop 提供的原生宿主接口；普通 DSH Web 不提供完整交互。

Laoboshi DSH App Manager is a desktop DSH plugin for registering and managing local apps. Its panel can detect projects, assign ports, start or stop apps, show logs, and edit API notes. It requires the native host interface in Laoboshi Desktop; regular DSH Web shows a compatibility notice.
想在 DSH 桌面里统一登记和启动本地开发项目。
I want to manage and inspect my local app processes from the DSH desktop.
Laoboshi DSH App Manager 的功能「登记并控制本地应用」：在应用管理面板填写项目目录、命令、参数和端口，也可尝试识别项目并自动分配端口；保存后可启动、停止或在浏览器打开应用。
Laoboshi DSH App Manager 的功能「查看运行信息与 API 文档」：在应用列表中搜索名称、目录、命令或端口，打开应用日志，并查看或保存该应用的 Markdown API 文档。

> The v0.1.0 UI uses native host capabilities supplied by Laoboshi Desktop. Stock DSH Web shows a compatibility notice.

text:
@laobos/dsh-app-manager README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Modole/dsh-plugin-app-manager-laoboshi.git
```

Restart `dsh web` after installation. DSH reads the `dsh.bundle` manifest and adds this package to the selected profile.
@laobos/dsh-app-manager README · Origin and author：Extracted from the built-in capability in [Laoboshi Agent Studio](https://github.com/Modole/laobos-agent-studio). Author: Modole.

@laobos/dsh-app-manager README · Security：Plugins execute with the current user's permissions. Review the source before installation and never post credentials, SSH private keys, or local runtime databases in issues.
